verdict.rationale: Entrust provides official mobile SDKs (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter planned) and documented API/SDK token flows for building custom integrations, which supports SDK-based development. However, this is a documentation-based confirmation rather than published, developer-facing SDK repos with hands-on examples or language coverage beyond mobile. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of SDK usability, broader language/server-side SDK coverage (e.g., web/JS backend SDKs beyond mobile), and public code samples or GitHub repos demonstrating agentic/AI-native integration patterns.
